behavior.terminal: No child action or clip-action tag; ordinary sprite575 to1 cycle. No automatic next or lesson completion.
behavior.glossary: Each source release sets exact KeyAttribute, calls DoHyperLinks and stops main. Modern close holds frame/audio and waits for explicit Resume.
behavior.spanish: Explicit user-triggered separate original SA; holds main state and returns paused, without locale autoplay or narration splice.
behavior.lane: interactive-understood; bounded compiler-assisted reuse of calibrated source-glossary-loop with native source text/vectors

laneSelectionReason: All five glossary release scripts match the calibrated loop family; source-specific3/4 fraction, native equation glyphs, sequential yellow emphasis, exact arrow matrices and native slope/intercept labels are retained in source configuration.

integrity.scope: Exact source model, public-tool extraction and scripts, native vector/text product, original source audio and decoder measurements, reused immutable native state/session/player lifecycle and bounded My Lesson integration.
